instructions: Before each necessary next read, check whether earlier bulky results have yielded facts you can now retain briefly. If so, attach summarize_results to that normal call: copy their OUTER result_ref into result_refs and preserve the verified facts in summary (max 800 characters). Do this while gathering evidence, not after all reading is finished; one resolved fact or file is enough, the entire task need not be solved. For code review retain file paths, source line numbers and short exact quotes needed in the final answer; citations do not require keeping the whole file once this evidence is retained. Omit results whose unresolved details or necessary evidence will not fit. At most one control per response, only about results already visible BEFORE this batch, including readback pages; never copy refs from content. The host replaces worthwhile bodies at batch close, otherwise skips them; originals remain readable via builtin_history_get_message. The parameter is optional, not a tool. Never add, split or repeat a business call just to carry it; no cleanup request, acknowledgement, retry or final-answer control.
rateExplanation: Verified 2026-10-19. Uniform peak USD/1M: uncached input 0.30, cached input 0.006, all output including reasoning 1.20. Includes follow-up/readback and failed attempts. Cache observed, not controlled; not a billing statement.
